meta.name: CCNL per i dipendenti da aziende dei settori Pubblici Esercizi, Ristorazione Collettiva e Commerciale e Turismo

notes.text: 2024 RENEWAL: CCNL signed 5 June 2024, validity 1 June 2024 – 31 December 2027 (CNEL H05Y, ~592,364 workers Uniemens 2022 / over 1 million according to FIPE). Pay table source: fipe.it/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Tabelle-retributive-2024.pdf.

SALARY MODEL: the contractual pay structure provides for a separate national base pay and contingenza. For engine purposes they are consolidated into base_salary (monthly total per tranche). The totals are read in the accordo integrativo of 26 June 2024 (pp. 1-2), the same as the FIPE pay tables. fixed_allowances models the function allowance for quadri: Qa=75 EUR and Qb=70 EUR, from Art. 154 of the CCNL of 8 February 2018 (CCNL 2024-2027).

CONTRACT CATERING: collective catering companies apply the June 2025 and June 2026 tranches from September (accordo integrativo 26 June 2024, p. 3); they are modelled in pubblici-esercizi-fipe-angem-ristorazione-collettiva. This file holds the June dates of the other sub-sectors.

limitation.remediation: Use pubblici-esercizi-fipe-angem-ristorazione-collettiva for a collective catering company.

notes.text: SMALLER COMPANIES: Art. 162 (PDF p. 118) reduces the paga base of the aziende minori dei pubblici esercizi and of the stabilimenti balneari of the third and fourth category (from EUR 2.58 for level 7 to EUR 5.68 for Qa, also in the accordo integrativo of 26 June 2024, pp. 4-6); art. 163 c. 2 prints a contingenza up to EUR 0.51 lower for them. Not modelled. Maximum impact: about EUR 6.19 a month for Qa.

limitation.remediation: Model the Art. 162 base-pay reduction for micro-enterprises with an employer-size input.

notes.text: APPRENTICESHIP (CCNL 8 February 2018, arts. 68 and 72, PDF pp. 74-75, read on the signed scan): the professionalizzante apprentice is paid 80%, 85% and 90% of the qualified pay of the level in the first three years (art. 68 c. 1). Durations (art. 72 c. 1): 36 months for levels 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6s, 24 months for level 6. Level 1, level 7 and the quadri are not apprenticeship destinations. Art. 75 (apprenticeship for qualification or diploma) is out of scope.
SENIORITY INCREMENTS: 6 quadrennial increments (48 months). Per-level amounts from FIPE pay tables (fipe.it/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Tabelle-retributive-2024.pdf). Paid over 14 monthly instalments.

MONTHLY PAYMENTS: 14, the tredicesima of Art. 183 and the quattordicesima of Art. 184 of the CCNL of 8 February 2018 (PDF pp. 127-128). The quattordicesima excludes the matured seniority increments (seniority_increments.excluded_from_extra_months).
HOURLY DIVISOR: 172 for a 40-hour week (Art. 160 of the CCNL of 8 February 2018, PDF p. 116; 190 for a 44-hour week, not modelled).
INPS: uses 2026-terziario.json (tax_sector terziario, same as commercio-confcommercio and turismo-federalberghi).

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: no clause says it in so many words. Art. 182 c. 1 (PDF p. 126) grants the six scatti 'A tutto il personale', art. 71 applies to the apprentice the normative treatment of the qualified worker, and art. 68 c. 1 pays a percentage of the qualified pay of the level, scatti included: the apprenticeship counts for the scatti and a matured scatto is paid at the apprentice percentage. The first scatto matures after 48 months, so only an apprentice with prior seniority reaches one; the engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: HOLIDAY OVERTIME: Art. 126 (PDF p. 99) gives 30% by day and 60% by night for every overtime hour; Art. 132 (p. 103) gives 20% for the hours worked on a festività. No clause links them: art. 126 c. 3 excludes cumulation only with ordinary night work, art. 130 c. 2 only Sunday work with the festività, and the special parts (arts. 246-247, 263-264) and the 2024 renewal repeat or leave them. The engine pays holiday overtime at 30%/60% without the 20%.

limitation.remediation: Confirm whether the 20% of art. 132 is added to the overtime rate on a festività; if so set the bands to 0.5 and 0.8, else close this note.

notes.text: APPRENTICESHIP PROFILES: art. 72 c. 2 gives 48 months to named profiles of levels 2 and 3 and 42 months to named profiles of level 4, and art. 68 c. 1 pays 95% in their fourth year. The profile is not an input: the engine pays them the 36-month track, 100% from month 37 instead of 95%.

limitation.remediation: Let the caller state the art. 72 c. 2 profile and add the 42 and 48 month tracks with the 95% fourth year.

notes.text: BALNEARI AND ALBERGHI DIURNI: art. 190 c. 5 (PDF p. 134) leaves the stabilimenti balneari and the alberghi diurni out of the sickness rule of the file: they pay the supplements of arts. 250 and 266 over the INPS 50%/66.66%, and the balneari non impiegati work 44 hours a week. Not modelled.

limitation.remediation: Model the special parts of the stabilimenti balneari and alberghi diurni in a sibling file.

notes.text: Art. 13 c. 10 of the renewal of 5 June 2024: the guarantee premium paid with the November 2027 pay to workers without second-level bargaining. The caller pays it as a variable item.

limitation.remediation: Model the 2027 guarantee premium as a conditional allowance.

notes.text: TRATTAMENTO INTEGRATIVO SPECIALE (L. 199/2025 art. 1 cc. 18-20, Gazzetta Ufficiale text, https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/atto/serie_generale/caricaArticolo?art.codiceRedazionale=26A00149&art.dataPubblicazioneGazzetta=2026-01-21&art.flagTipoArticolo=0&art.idArticolo=1&art.idGruppo=1&art.idSottoArticolo=1&art.idSottoArticolo1=10&art.progressivo=1&art.versione=1, page sha256 e05f6f864509f87e7488cdae075fe3a1f2632f6f4577b87ee05479a1ed193c1d): from 1 January to 30 September 2026 the workers of the esercizi di somministrazione di alimenti e bevande (L. 287/1991 art. 5) and of the 'comparto del turismo, ivi inclusi gli stabilimenti termali', with employment income of 2025 not above 40,000 EUR, receive 'un trattamento integrativo speciale, che non concorre alla formazione del reddito, pari al 15 per cento delle retribuzioni lorde corrisposte in relazione al lavoro notturno e alle prestazioni di lavoro straordinario [...] effettuate nei giorni festivi'. The employer pays it 'su richiesta del lavoratore' (c. 20), a fact the request has no field for: the engine does not pay it, so the net pay of a worker who asked for it is understated.

limitation.remediation: Add the worker's request of c. 20 to the request, pay 15% of the night and holiday overtime pay of the run as a credit, then remove this note.

notes.text: HOURLY RATE AND SUPPLEMENTS (artt. 124, 130, 132, 157, 160 of the 2018 text, unchanged by the 2024 renewal): without a caller value the engine derives the hourly base (the art. 157 retribuzione over 172), the 25% on ordinary night hours from 24 to 6 (art. 124), the 20% on the hours worked on a festività (art. 132) and the 10% of the hourly paga base and contingenza on ordinary Sunday hours of a worker resting on another day (art. 130). Art. 132 also pays the festività hours themselves on top of the monthly pay: the engine posts the 20% only and the run is provisional. Not derived: holiday and night holiday overtime (art. 126 sets no rate; the bands OT_FESTIVO and OT_NOTTURNO_FESTIVO stay derived), the divisor 190 of the 44-hour week.

LEAVE, STABILIMENTI BALNEARI (Art. 114 cc.2 and 4): 108 hours a year and 38 more hours after two years for the new hires, instead of 104 and 36; the seasonal contracts of Artt. 89-90 keep the whole reduction. The engine accrues the hours of the generalità.

limitation.remediation: Add employer and contract facts for the balneari and the seasonal contracts.

notes.text: LEAVE AT TERMINATION: no clause of the OCR of the 2018 text read states the basis of the indemnity for the ferie and permits not taken; the engine pays no residual (termination_residual_leave incomplete).

location.section: Art. 182 c. 5 - Scatti di anzianità
location.quote: Nel caso in cui nel corso del quadriennio intercorrente tra l'uno e l'altro scatto siano intervenuti passaggi a livello superiore, gli importi relativi agli scatti precedenti saranno ricalcolati in base al nuovo valore al momento di maturazione del nuovo scatto senza liquidazione di arretrati per il periodo pregresso.

provenance.transformation: at_next_increment = true: the increments matured before a promotion keep the amount of the level they were matured at until the next increment matures, then every increment takes the amount of the new level.
provenance.note: Read on the scanned page (printed page 125).

location.section: Capo VIII - Articolo 182 Scatti di anzianità
location.quote: A tutto il personale verranno riconosciuti sei scatti [...] Dal 1° gennaio 2018, gli scatti quadriennali decorreranno dal primo giorno del mese immediatamente successivo

provenance.note: The increments are left out of the quattordicesima: art. 184 c. 1 (p. 128) pays 'una mensilità della retribuzione in atto al 30 giugno [...] esclusi gli assegni familiari e gli scatti di anzianità maturati'; the tredicesima of art. 183 c. 1 (p. 127) includes 'eventuali scatti di anzianità'.

location.section: Articolo 183 c. 2 (tredicesima) and articolo 184 c. 4 (quattordicesima)
location.quote: le frazioni di mese saranno cumulate. La somma così ottenuta comporterà la corresponsione di un rateo mensile per ogni trenta giorni di calendario, nonché per la eventuale frazione residua pari o superiore a quindici giorni. La frazione inferiore ai quindici giorni non verrà considerata.

provenance.transformation: A whole month accrues a rateo; the calendar days of the months worked in part (start, end, or reduced work) are summed: a rateo for each 30 days and one for a remainder of 15 days or more.
provenance.note: Scanned CCNL read by OCR and checked on the page images (pp. 127-128). Same wording for the tredicesima (art. 183 c. 2) and the quattordicesima (art. 184 c. 4).

location.section: Articolo 190 - Prestazioni; Articolo 194 - Conservazione del posto
location.quote: indennità di malattia da corrispondersi dall'INPS nella misura dell'80 per cento [...] per i primi tre giorni di malattia (periodo di carenza) qualora la durata della malattia superi i cinque giorni

provenance.transformation: Art. 190 c. 3: INPS pays the indemnity at 80% (regime pubblici_esercizi of sickness/indemnity/rates.json) and the CCNL adds no top-up, so the target is 0.8; the employer pays the normal pay for the three days of carenza only when the sickness lasts more than five days (carenza_min_days 5). Art. 194: 180 days a year, from 1 January to 31 December.

reviews.scope: Every payable rule of the file (72 records) and the hourly divisor read again in the signed texts: the CCNL of 8 February 2018, the renewal of 5 June 2024 and its accordo integrativo of 26 June 2024 with the final salary tables.
findings: All 50 salary periods and the 10 level rows match the accordo integrativo of 26 June 2024 (pp. 1-2) and are verified, with the Quadri allowances (Art. 154), the 14 monthly payments (Artt. 183-184), seniority (Art. 182), overtime 30% and 60% (Art. 126), the daily quota 1/26 (Art. 159), leave (Art. 134) and the hourly divisor 172 (Art. 160). Pages are PDF page indexes.

Corrected: sickness (Art. 190, Art. 194). INPS pays 80% for the whole sickness in this sector (regime pubblici_esercizi, funded by the 0.77% supplement) and the CCNL adds no top-up, so the target is 80%; the three days of carenza are paid in full only when the sickness lasts more than five days; the comporto is 180 days a calendar year.

Assumed: the overtime bands for holidays (30%) and holiday nights (60%). The CCNL sets only 30% by day and 60% by night (Art. 126) and 20% for ordinary work on a holiday (Art. 132); the two bands are inferences, not cited values.
Left derived: the Fon.Te. rates, read in the fund's information sheet, not in the CCNL.

Not modelled: the quattordicesima excludes the seniority increments (Art. 184), the collective catering companies move the June 2025 and June 2026 tranches to September (accordo integrativo p. 3), and the conditions of Art. 190 beyond the carenza.

FIPE and the Turismo CCNLs are two agreements: FIPE was renewed on 5 June 2024 (level 4 at 1,692.69 from June 2026), the Turismo CCNL of Federalberghi and Faita on 5 July 2024 (1,695.69 from May 2026).

reviews.scope: Quattordicesima and seniority, holiday overtime, September tranches of the ristorazione collettiva: follow-ups of the review of 2026-10-11.
findings: Quattordicesima: art. 184 c. 1 excludes the matured seniority increments; the engine paid them. Now excluded.
Holiday overtime: the 30% and 60% are art. 126 itself (by time of day), not an analogy: derived from p. 99; whether art. 132's 20% is added is left open (outside_input note).

Ristorazione collettiva: the 2025 and 2026 tranches start in September for the companies of art. 1 c. 1 par. II (accordo integrativo 26.6.2024, p. 3); still the limitation contract_catering_tranche_dates.

reviews.scope: Accrual of the tredicesima and quattordicesima (artt. 183 c. 2 and 184 c. 4).
findings: The accrual rule was missing (engine default of 15 days per month): the CCNL cumulates the fractions of month, a rateo for each 30 days and one for a remainder of 15 days or more, now modelled (cumulated_fractions).

reviews.scope: Every payable rule not yet verified, the apprenticeship (arts. 68 and 72), the limitations and the L2 values, for the production tier.
findings: 2 records verified on the signed texts (salary periods on the accordo integrativo of 26 June 2024, accrual rule and Fon.Te. on the CCNL of 8 February 2018).
Fon.Te.: 0.55% employer and worker on the TFR base, art. 185 c. 3; valid from 29 November 1996 (the fund table), not from 2026.
Apprenticeship: level 1 is not a destination; level 6 lasts 24 months (art. 72 c. 1), now its own track; the 42 and 48 month profiles stay a limitation.
Holiday overtime: whether the 20% of art. 132 adds to the 30%/60% of art. 126 is not stated; the two bands stay derived with the limitation.

L2: INPS terziario verified (circ. 117/2022 allegato accepted on 2026-10-13), with the 0.77% sickness supplement of the pubblici esercizi (CCNL art. 190 c. 3); TFR art. 217, the scatti included since 1 November 2021.
No renewal after the accordo integrativo of 26 June 2024 changes gross pay.

reviews.scope: The paga base and contingenza of every level from June 2024 against the accordo integrativo of 26 June 2024, the quattordicesima against the CCNL of 8 February 2018, and a year and a termination of a 4th level worker against a hand oracle.
findings: Accordo integrativo of 26 June 2024 (pp. 1-3): the 50 totals of contingenza and paga base of the ten levels from June 2024 to December 2027 match the file, with the tranches of 2025 and 2026 in June.
Art. 184 of the CCNL of 8 February 2018 (p. 128, scan read by OCR): quattordicesima of the pay in force on 30 June, paid with the July pay, in ratei of the twelve months before 1 July. Match.

Hand oracle (tests/knowledge/ccnl_engine/period/sector, scenarios fipe-year and fipe-june): a 4th level impiegato hired on 1 January 2026 by an employer with 10 employees, with the terziario rates up to 15 employees and the 0.77% sickness supplement of the pubblici esercizi taken apart; every payment and the year (gross, contributions, tax, net, TFR, employer cost) match the engine to the cent. The CCNL now covers every total of the definition of done.

reviews.scope: Hourly base of the time supplements and the supplements of ordinary night, holiday, Sunday, rest-day and shift work, read in the cited articles of the national text (text layer, or OCR of the scanned pages). AI review only: the same model extracted and checked the values.
findings: hourly_base_method gross_incl_allowances (was minimo_tabellare), now verified: the engine reads it to derive the hourly rate of an event without one.
Supplement bands added: FIPE_NOTTURNO, FIPE_FESTIVO, FIPE_DOMENICA.
Bands left out where the rate depends on facts the request does not carry or the text is unconfirmed; listed in the coverage note HOURLY RATE AND SUPPLEMENTS.

reviews.scope: Leave accrual: the ferie twelfths and month rule, the hours of each permit bucket (ROL, ex festività or the pooled PAR), the new-hire ramps and the basis of the indemnity for the residual leave at termination, read on the text cited by each rule. An AI review: the extractor is also the verifier.
findings: The values stated are those of the quoted clauses; what the texts leave open (month fractions, termination divisors, schedules and shift patterns) is not modelled and is recorded in the coverage notes.

reviews.scope: The renewal within the window of L. 199/2025 art. 1 c. 7 and the minimo in force before its first tranche.
findings: Renewal signed on 2024-06-05, first tranche from 2024-06-01: parameters.renewals.

Minimo before the renewal = paga base before the tranche of June 2024 plus the contingenza, unchanged by it (the Totale the bundle carries): e.g. level 3, 1,130.81 + 528.26 = 1,659.07. The paga base is the table of December 2021 of the CCNL of 8 February 2018 (p. 117, column 'dic-21', read by OCR).

reviews.scope: The pricing of the seniority increments matured before a change of level (Art. 182 c. 5 - Scatti di anzianità).
findings: Art. 182 c. 5 - Scatti di anzianità (p. 127): the earlier increments are repriced at the new level when the next one matures: seniority_increments.on_promotion.

reviews.scope: Whether the individual elements of the worker (superminimi, aumenti di merito, assegni ad personam) enter the hourly base of overtime and supplements (Art. 157 c. 1 - Elementi della retribuzione).
findings: Art. 157 c. 1 - Elementi della retribuzione: individual elements excluded in the hourly base: work_rules.time_supplements.individual_elements.
